question: **Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution: The erroneous spelling is '**Journies**'. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • Among the given options, the incorrectly spelt word is '**Journies**'. • Its correct spelling is '**Journeys**'. • It means **'the act of travelling from one place to another, usually on land'.** [एक स्‍थान से दूसरे स्‍थान की यात्रा (प्रायः ज़मीन पर), सफ़र] • *Example: a two-hour **journey**...* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** • Let's look at the **meaning **of other words: • **Opportunities**: a chance to do something that you would like to do; a situation or a time in which it is possible to do something that you would like to do. (अवसर, सुअवसर, मौक़ा; उपयुक्त, अवसरानुकूल सि्‍थति या समय) • **Capabilities**: the power or ability to do something. (कुछ करने की शक्ति या क्षमता) • **Responsibilities**: the opportunity or ability to act independently and take decisions without authorization. (स्वतंत्र रूप से कार्य करने और प्राधिकरण के बिना निर्णय लेने का अवसर या क्षमता) 3e:T9eb, The correct answer is '**Accord**'.
